jobs.description:
**Amazon Content Strategist | eCommerce Agency | 1P & 3P**

***Salary***
*- DOE + Bonus + Benefits*

***Location***
*- London Hybrid (3 days in office, Tue–Thu)*

***VA Reference***
*- 9444*

We’re working with an international, technology-led eCommerce partner that helps global brands grow across Amazon and other marketplaces. The business is investor-backed and growing fast. They’re creating a new Amazon Content Strategist role in their creative content team, working on brands across a wide range of consumer categories.

When a client’s sales start slipping, you’ll be the person who works out why. You’ll audit their content, read the signals in reviews, search terms and AI-generated summaries, then build the strategy to improve conversion and present it back to the client. You’ll do the strategy and stay close to the execution, briefing copywriters and designers so the work lands as intended.

* Brief and review the work of copywriters, designers and SEO colleagues.
* Present strategies and recommendations directly to clients and answer their questions.
* Test, measure and refine what works.

**What you’ll bring**

Essential:

* Hands-on Amazon content experience: listings, A+ and Brand Store.
* Confidence presenting your thinking to clients or senior stakeholders.
* Fluency in where Amazon is heading, including AI-driven discovery and content compliance.
* The ability to brief creative teams clearly.

Desirable:

* Both vendor (1P) and seller (3P) experience.
* An agency background working across multiple categories.
* Experience on other marketplaces or retailer.com sites.

jobs.title: Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
**Partnerships Manager**
========================

**Location:** Los Angeles, New York, London, Remote (US preferred)

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**About Reacher**
-----------------

Reacher is the AI-powered social commerce platform for brands and creators. We started on TikTok Shop, where we’re an official partner, and we now also build for Meta, YouTube Shopping, Amazon, and Shopify, so brands can run their creator and affiliate programs on every channel from one place. More than 2,000 brands use Reacher Pro to find creators, run outreach, and manage their programs end to end. Reacher Plus is our AI-native managed service, and the Reacher Creator app helps thousands of creators earn more, paying out over $500K to creators every month.

We’re backed by Y Combinator and Steve Huffman (CEO of Reddit), have years of runway, and have tripled revenue in the last year. Our team of 35 works across the US, Europe, and Asia. It’s a small team growing fast, so the work you do here has a real impact on brands and creators from day one.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a **Partnerships Manager** to own three of the highest-leverage relationships at Reacher: our top strategic accounts, the TikTok ecosystem (TikTok Shop US/UK partnerships, category teams, and the TSP network), and our agency partner ecosystem (holding companies, TSPs, and creator agencies).

This role reports directly to the co-founder running GTM and works closely with the CEO.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **TikTok Ecosystem Partnerships**

* Own the day-to-day relationship with TikTok Shop's US and UK partnership, category, and TSP teams
* Drive Reacher's TikTok Shop Partner (TSP) certification end-to-end and maintain our positioning in the unified TSP ecosystem
* Plan and execute joint webinars, trainings, and category enablement sessions for TikTok's seller and TSP teams
* Represent Reacher in TikTok partner groups (Lark, Slack), events, and city-tour activations
* Surface platform-level signals (new permissions, beta programs, category opportunities) back to Product and GTM

### **Strategic Account Management**

* Own the relationship with our top 20–30 strategic accounts: holding companies (Omnicom/Flywheel, Publicis, Dentsu), enterprise brands (ABH, ColourPop, SKIN1004, Pandora-tier), and high-GMV Reacher Plus clients
* Run a structured cadence (weekly to monthly depending on tier) with each account's executive sponsor
* Move strategic accounts from product user to executive partner through QBRs, joint goal-setting, and expansion planning
* Own renewal and expansion conversations for the strategic tier in partnership with sales and Reacher Plus delivery
* Convert at-risk strategic accounts into wins through escalation, executive relationships, and product partnership

### **Agency & TSP Partnerships**

* Build and maintain co-sell and co-marketing relationships with TSPs and creator agencies
* Run a referral motion that turns agency partners into a consistent source of net new brand pipeline
* Negotiate co-marketing programs: joint case studies, webinars, event presence, content swaps
* Activate dormant agency relationships and identify new TSPs to onboard

### **Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Partner with Sales on enterprise pipeline and deal strategy
* Partner with Reacher Plus delivery on strategic account health and executive relationships
* Partner with Product on platform-level requests from TikTok and top accounts
* Report partnership pipeline, account health, and ecosystem signals to the founders weekly

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
---------------------------

### **Required**

* 3–6+ years in partnerships, strategic accounts, or business development at a SaaS, commerce, or creator economy platform
* Track record managing 20+ strategic accounts simultaneously with executive-level relationships
* Demonstrated experience closing co-marketing and co-sell deals, not just maintaining relationships
* Strong written communicator who can run a cadence, log outcomes, and drive accountability without prompting
* Comfortable in a fast-moving startup environment with no existing playbook
* Strong execution capability (not strategy-only)

### **Preferred**

* Existing relationships inside TikTok Shop (US or UK partnership orgs, category teams, or partner ecosystem)
* Prior experience at a TikTok Shop Partner (TSP), creator agency, or holding company in the social commerce space
* Experience taking a SaaS company through a platform partner certification (TSP, Shopify Plus, Meta Business Partner, Amazon Ads Partner, etc.)
* Working knowledge of the creator economy, affiliate marketing, or social commerce business models

### **This Role Is Not For You If**

* You expect to inherit a playbook — there isn't one yet, and building it is part of the job
* You prefer relationship-building over closing concrete co-sell, co-marketing, or expansion outcomes
* You can't context-switch between an enterprise QBR in the morning and a tactical webinar plan in the afternoon

jobs.title: Content & Community Manager, PerfectDraft UK

Seniority Level: Associate
  
  
**#Ownership**
**About PerfectDraft**
At Budweiser Brewing Group, dreaming big is what we do. Brewing the world’s most loved beers, building iconic brands like Budweiser, Stella Artois, Corona and crafting meaningful moments are what inspire us. We’re a team of passionate owners who aren’t afraid to dream big because we know that together, we can achieve anything. To build a more sustainable, inclusive, and rewarding future. Turning any challenge into an opportunity.

There are more than 40 beers available to serve with PerfectDraft from craft beers to Belgian Classics, Classic German Lagers to fruity brews. All served how the brewer intended.
  
  
PerfectDraft is at the forefront of ecommerce, technology and brewing. Our strategy has been to launch and grow the PerfectDraft brand, product range and customer base via our own Direct to Consumer eCommerce stores in Europe. * Life assurance & charitable giving

We recruit for mindset, ambition, cultural fit, and growth opportunities.

We are proud to be part of something bigger than ourselves and are passionate about building upon our company’s long legacy. We believe in collaboration and candor, which results in a dynamic culture with open communication.
  
  
**BRANDS EVERYONE LOVES**
We are part of the collective, global history of beer. We are the proud makers of more than 500 iconic brands, from beloved international classics to local favorites.

Our people grow at the pace of their talent. We empower our people to learn, expand their perspectives, and unlock career growth. In an environment where commitment to excellence pays off, our people are able to deepen their impact and create a long-lasting legacy.

jobs.title: Customer Marketing Associate
jobs.description:
*Hi, I'm Chris. I'm a Lead Product Marketing Manager at hx - I joined over four years ago as a Product Marketing Manager. Outside of work you'll find me playing sport (badly), watching reality TV, or taking my dog Lucky to the park (or the pub!).*
*Product (or Customer) Marketing at hx is a strategic function. We shape the company's positioning and messaging, decide where and when products launch, and build the process that gets them to market. We're growing the team because customer case studies are critical to our success: insurance is a tight-knit industry that trusts practitioner voices far more than it trusts vendors.*
*This role is a chance to help shape the narrative we take to market and have a global impact on our success. You'll need to be comfortable managing senior stakeholders and have great taste - but what matters most is drive, and a willingness to solve problems as you find them. In return, you'll join a team that's kind, supportive, and full of very smart people who want to go fast and far. If that sounds like you, read on!*
**About Hyperexponential (hx)**
At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.
  
  
Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.
  
  
Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.
  
  
What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.
  
  
What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.
  
  
If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.
  
  
**About The Product Marketing Team**
Product Marketing sits at the centre of hx's go-to-market engine, translating what we build into stories the market believes. Nothing earns that belief faster than a customer saying it themselves: insurance is an industry where reputation travels through a small number of trusted voices, and our customers include some of the most respected names in specialty and commercial insurance.
  
  
As our Customer Marketing Manager, you'll own that voice. Your mission is to increase the frequency, quality, and number of published customer case studies, build relationships with customer accounts so that every testimonial is genuinely mutually beneficial, find new ways to celebrate our customers, and manage award submissions that earn industry recognition for hx and the customers we serve.
  
  
This is a role with real ownership from day one. You'll work directly with senior stakeholders at hx and at some of the world's largest insurers, and the content you produce will be used across sales, marketing, and events globally.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Own case study production end to end - from identifying the story and recruiting the customer through to publication - delivering two published case studies (written, video, or otherwise) per quarter.
* Publish two additional pieces of customer-contributed content per quarter, from quotes and social content to event appearances, driving hx's key messages to market through customer voices.
* Build and continually improve our case study recruitment and production process so that participating is low-lift for both our customers and our team, and each cycle runs smoother than the last.
* Grow engagement across the underwriting community, measured through event attendance, email open rates, and social engagement, particularly on LinkedIn.
* Identify and manage award submissions throughout the year, coordinating internal and customer stakeholders to produce a targeted number of high-quality entries that increase industry recognition for hx and its customers.
* Edit and assemble short-form written, video, and social content for promotion and lead generation, keeping every asset aligned with hx's positioning and brand narrative.

What you'll need to have done
  
  

* Taken customer stories or content projects from initial idea through to publication, coordinating multiple senior, time-limited stakeholders inside and outside your organisation.
* Built content programmes or campaigns where the relationship mattered as much as the output - securing participation, managing approvals and consent, and leaving customers glad they took part.
* Produced short-form written and video content yourself, with the functional writing and editing skills to create new assets and make light edits without waiting on others.
* Grown an audience or generated leads through social content, particularly by editing and assembling content for LinkedIn.
* Demonstrated strong instincts for positioning and messaging - shaping stories that align with a brand narrative rather than just documenting what happened.
* Improved a process so it lasted: found the friction, fixed it, and made the next cycle measurably easier for everyone involved.

**Why Harvey**
At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.
  
  
This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.
  
  
Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.
  
  
At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We’re looking for an innovative and hands-on Senior Customer Marketing Manager to put Harvey’s EMEA customers centre stage: telling their stories, celebrating their wins, and building community around them.
  
  
Harvey has an incredible base of law firm and in-house customers across the region, and they are truly innovating the practice of law. Your first job is to elevate their voices: finding the customers doing standout work, earning their trust, and producing the written, video and spoken stories that put that work in front of the industry.
  
  
From there, the role expands into community programming: building the communities, programmes and moments (power user groups, customer roundtables, awards and recognition moments, customer-led content) that bring customers and the wider legal community together.
  
  
You’ll sit within the EMEA Marketing team and work hand in glove with our global Customer Engagement team, who own the overarching customer marketing strategy, programmes and playbooks. Your job is to make them work for EMEA: adapting them for the region’s markets, customers and culture, building what the region needs on top, and feeding what you learn back into the global motion. You’ll also partner closely with Customer Success and Sales. As the first dedicated customer marketer in the region, you won’t inherit a finished playbook. You’ll help write it.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Localise the global motion for EMEA: take the programmes, playbooks and frameworks our Customer Engagement team builds globally and tailor them specifically for EMEA markets, customers and culture, working hand-in-hand to build a truly exceptional motion.
* Build the EMEA customer story pipeline: work across customer-facing teams to find the customers doing standout work, secure their participation and approvals, and keep a steady flow of stories in production.
* Tell their stories: own written stories, video stories, quotes and references end to end and to a standard the customer is proud to share.
* Get the stories seen: package each story for the channels that give it reach, localised for priority EMEA markets, and make sure Sales knows what exists and how to use it.
* Build the advocate bench: develop a roster of EMEA customers who can act as references, speakers, panellists and peer connectors, and track their participation so no one is over-asked and everyone gets recognised.
* Build EMEA community programmes: design and run the formats that bring customers together, such as power user groups, customer roundtables, practitioner communities, awards and recognition moments, each with clear goals and structured follow-up.
* Build repeatable playbooks and processes: the story production workflow, approvals process, reference tracking and community operating rhythm, so each new story and programme is faster to stand up than the last.
* Measure and improve impact: track stories produced, proof usage, reference activity, community engagement and contribution to pipeline, renewals and expansion.

**What You Have**

* 4-7 years of experience in customer marketing, customer advocacy, content marketing or community, ideally in B2B SaaS, technology or professional services.
* Proven experience producing content end to end. Excellent writer and interviewer, with the judgement to find the real story and the credibility to earn trust with senior legal and business leaders.
* Experience building or running events, customer communities and advocacy programmes.
* Strong relationship instincts: you enjoy spending time with customers and build trust quickly with them, Sales and Customer Success.
* Highly organised and operationally rigorous, with the ability to run multiple stories, programmes and stakeholders at once.
* Comfortable working autonomously and building from scratch in a fast-moving environment.
* Familiarity with using AI to scale your own work.
* Experience marketing to legal, financial services, consulting, enterprise or other high-touch professional audiences is a plus. Additional European languages are a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing & Audience Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
Join POLITICO’s Events team in Europe to grow, engage and amplify audiences for POLITICO Live.
  
  
The
**Senior Marketing & Audience Manager**
is a hands-on, all-round event marketer responsible for delivering marketing and audience recruitment campaigns and leading event amplification across POLITICO’s European events portfolio.
  
  
We’re looking for someone with
**fresh ideas, energy and creativity**
— someone ready to challenge the traditional event marketing playbook, experiment with new approaches and find innovative ways to engage audiences
**before, during and after our events**
.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong events marketing experience with a broader marketing background, including social media, CRM and digital campaigns, and experience mentoring or managing others. They will understand
**who needs to be in the room**
across the French, British, Spanish and EU policy communities.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Working with the Executive Director of Audience and Growth, lead the event audience team and deliver integrated marketing and audience recruitment campaigns.
* Drive registrations and attendance while attracting the right audiences for each event.
* Lead event amplification, finding creative ways to extend the reach and impact of our events before, during and after they happen.
* Bring fresh ideas, test new approaches and challenge established ways of working.
* Develop campaigns across email, CRM, social media, newsletters and other POLITICO channels.
* Use CRM and event marketing tools to effectively segment, target and engage audiences.
* Track performance and use data and insights to improve results.
* Collaborate with Events, Marketing, Editorial and Commercial teams to maximize the reach of POLITICO Live.

**What You'll Need**

* 6+ years of experience in events marketing, audience development or wider marketing.
* Team management experience.
* Strong all-round marketer with hands-on event promotion experience.
* Creative and curious, with the confidence to experiment and bring new ideas.
* Strong understanding of social media, email, CRM and digital marketing.
* Strong copywriting, organizational and project management skills.
* Data-driven and comfortable measuring and optimising campaigns.
* Able to manage multiple campaigns in a fast-paced environment.
* Fluent English; French and/or Spanish is a plus.
* Experience in media, policy, journalism or political events is an advantage.

**We value our people**
**Our Benefits Package Is Built For You, And Includes**

* Our teams benefit from country-specific, competitive compensation and benefits packages—including pension, healthcare, training opportunities and more.
* With a multinational team, strong ties to EU institutions, and flexible work options including working from abroad, we offer our employees an environment that supports both professional and personal development.

**Let’s keep in touch**
You can view our list of open positions here. We hope to see your application soon!
  
  
**About Us**
POLITICO illuminates the forces shaping global power. Since 2007, we have delivered intelligence that anticipates tomorrow's headlines, not reports on yesterday's news. As politics has increasingly become the defining force of our era, our work has never been more vital.
  
  
Cabinet secretaries and Ministers start their mornings with our analysis. CEOs shape strategy around our reporting. Advocacy leaders rely on our insights to move policy. We deliver the straightforward facts and clear-eyed analysis they need to navigate the most complex political landscape of our lifetimes.
  
  
Our 1,100+ publishing professionals across the world's key democratic capitals—Washington, Brussels, London, Paris, Berlin, Sacramento, and New York—form the world's premier politics and policy newsroom. We tell the story of how power really works by explaining who wields it and how they plan to exercise it, connecting dots others miss and delivering scoops from sources others don't even know exist.
  
  
Innovation has always been a core tenet of our story. At launch, we bet that depth would trump scale, that talent would trump traffic, and that politics would become central to modern life. In 2011, we made another bet and launched POLITICO Pro to help decision-makers understand the business of government, transforming both how they shape government action and the business of journalism itself.
  
  
These bets have made POLITICO the most successful digital news startup of its generation and the indispensable resource for leaders who shape the future. Today, we are a rarity in media: a growing, profitable, and sustainable news organization.
  
  
POLITICO is a subsidiary of Axel Springer SE, a family-owned transatlantic media company headquartered in Berlin and New York. Axel Springer is dedicated to shaping the future of journalism in the free world, believing that a free and informed society is essential to democracy. The company’s guiding principles - first articulated as The Essentials by founder Axel Springer in the aftermath of World War II - remain a cornerstone of the company’s foundation today. Learn more about Axel Springer.

2026-08-30
